# AGENCY

> AGENCY is a small-business incubator delivered as software, by DakJen
> Creative LLC. Owner-operated businesses register, invoice their clients,
> get paid, keep their books, budget, price their work, send contracts,
> manage contractors and take classes — in one place, with real people
> behind it.

## How it works

- No monthly fee, no annual contract. AGENCY takes a single percentage of
  what a member collects through the platform; that one number covers
  payment processing (bank transfer), every tool, and access to the team.
- The percentage falls as a member's revenue grows.
- New members get 7 days of full access before connecting anything.
- Payments run on Stripe Connect; AGENCY never holds member funds.

## What's included

Invoicing & payments, bookkeeping, budgeting & pricing tools, business and
DBA registration, contracts, contractor management, business email,
consulting & meetings, classes & resources, business connections.

Website builds, portfolios and campaigns are studio services from DakJen
Creative, quoted separately.
